title: Newhalo investor access
description: A private access page on a window-tall near-black screen: one centred graphite card with a 4px orange rule along its top, 18px corners and a long soft shadow. An orange wordmark, small spaced orange capitals, a bold, tightly tracked 66px heading, and two numbered document cards that lift 3px and take an orange border on hover, each ending in a bold orange link.
notes: sized by the window (min-h-svh); a standalone page with no header or footer, as in the original
the original sets this page in a bold neo-grotesk; here it uses the theme's body face at bold weight
